note: The roster of all 20 rivals: one per boss rule, assigned to the six Leagues (docs/ROADMAP.md). Names are working character names (design §18). Full identities (intro, reactions, first clear) are written in each League's spec; portraits, colours and presentation are Codex's E21 work.

rivals.name: The Surveyor
rivals.signature: Measures every line; no charged spin.

rivals.name: The Custodian
rivals.signature: Only clean frames count: strikes and spares.

rivals.name: The Proprietor
rivals.signature: Owns the alley; House Ball only.

rivals.name: Old Lou
rivals.signature: Forty years on these lanes; every pin plays as plain Wood.

rivals.name: Slick
rivals.signature: Iridescent oil halves every hook.

rivals.name: Laser Lena
rivals.signature: Neon rails pull the gutters in.

rivals.name: DJ Flicker
rivals.signature: A strobing ring with half-size sweet spots.

rivals.name: Miser Moll
rivals.signature: Pays nothing for items during her match.

rivals.name: Grimewell
rivals.signature: Grime halves every pin's Value.

rivals.name: Scrapjack
rivals.signature: Rusts every modification shut.

rivals.name: The Duchess
rivals.signature: One roll per frame; no second chances.

rivals.name: Lord Tally
rivals.signature: Keeps the books: Mult stops at 20.

rivals.name: The Herald
rivals.signature: The head pin must fall first.

rivals.name: The Winter Widow
rivals.signature: Freezes the first Charm slot.

rivals.name: The Hush
rivals.signature: Nothing echoes: retriggers are silenced.

rivals.name: Wisp
rivals.signature: First-roll pins fade to half Value.

rivals.name: Iron Mae
rivals.signature: Reinforced pins at one and a half times the weight.

rivals.name: Glassjaw
rivals.signature: Fallen pins may crack into Wood.

rivals.name: Foreman Kole
rivals.signature: Only the ball's own hits count.

rivals.name: Gauge
rivals.signature: Small frames don't move the needle.
